create_message_queue_distributed: create a MessageQueue for a distributed process group with one writer and multiple readers
create_message_queue_single_reader: create a MessageQueue for a process group with a single reader and multiple writers
build_shm_ring_buffer: build a shared memory ring buffer for lock-free producer-consumer communication between processes
build_spin_condition: build a spin condition that notifies readers to wake up from a zmq socket after idle mode
run_broadcast_object: run broadcast_object to enqueue an object from the writer and dequeue it from all readers
